title: Credit Suisse adds 1,200 jobs in North Carolina
description: Credit Suisse adds 1,200 jobs in North Carolina

asr.full_text: THE SHELL AGO. REPORTERS SAID THERE ISN'T A REPORT ON THE NAME. NEIGHBORS SAY THE MAN WHO BROUGHT THIS KING PARTICIPATED IN THE CRASH. CREDIT SUISS IS BRINGING 1,200 JOBS WITH AN AVERAGE SIX FIGURE SALARY. CBS NORTH CAROLINA JOINS US LIVE FROM CREDIT SUISS IN MORRISVILLE. WHERE THE JOBS ANNOUNCEMENT WAS MADE TODAY. BOW, WHAT TYPES OF JOBS WILL THEY BE HIRTING? SHARON, THE COMPANY TELLS ME THEY WILL BE HIRING A LOT OF I.T. AND OPERATIONS JOBS, ALSO SUPPORT FOR THEIR TRAITORS operations jobs also support for their traders and bankers in new york the company has a planned expansion of its facility here but it's a move that almost didn't happen for months there has been speculation of a major jobs announcement coming to wake county it's no longer speculation they're going to be a lot of people who are going to want these jobs and we want them to apply and we're ready to take off Financial Services Company credit Swiss is expanding its RTP operations the company will invest more than 70 million dollars to make that expansion happen in the next several years there will be 1,200 more jobs with average six-figure salaries Credit Suisse administrators say some of those will be transfers and some will be new hires DURING THE DISCUSSIONS. THE WORKFORCE SAID IT SIGNALS THAT NO ONE CAN INVEST IN TRANSFER RENONRES WITH SIX FIGURE SALARIES. CRADDIT SWISS ADMINISTRATORS SAY SOME OF THOSE WILL BE TRANSFERS AND SOME WILL BE NEW HIRES. BUT THEY HAVE NOT SAID HOW MANY WILL BE NEW HIRES. WE WILL BE EXPANDING AND WE NEED TO HAVE A HIGH FOCUS IN TERMS OF OUR RECRUITING, DIVERSITY, INCLUSION. COMPANY LEADERS SPOKE SEVERAL TIMEDED INCLUSION TO EXPAND THE MONEY. AT LEAST 3 MILLION COMPANIES HAVE ASKED FOR INCLUSION. THEY SAY THE COMPANY OPPOSED HB2 AND HALTED ITS EXPANSION PLANS WHILE IT WAS ON THE BOOKS. THEY SAY WHEN IT WAS REPEALED, IT RESTABLISH THEY ARE MINIMUM CONDITIONS TO EXPAND IN NORTH CAROLINA. IT IS SOMETHING THAT SOME OF THE OTHER BIG ORGANIZATIONS LOOKING AT THE STATE CONCLUSION THEY ALSO CAME TO. FOR US, WAS SHAP. TO START THE INVESTIGATION WAS SOMETHING HE WAS REASURABLE ABOUT. SO FOR US IT WAS, IT SHOWED TO US THAT NORTH CAROLINA WAS ON THE RIGHT PATH. THEY SAY THE REPEAL DEAL IS NOT PERFECT BUT IS A FIRST STEP FORWARD. AHEAD AT 6 O'CLOCK WE WILL TAKE A CLOSER LOOK AT THE WAKE COUNTY IMPACT AND WHY

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a CBS North Carolina news report about Credit Suisse's planned expansion and 1,200 jobs in Wake County. The employment information involves applying for jobs, not making a payment, investing money, providing credentials, or meeting another financial participation requirement. The mention of average six-figure salaries is framed as ordinary employment reporting rather than a guaranteed wealth claim or solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is general television news coverage of a company's expansion and employment announcement, rather than a scam mechanism, investment solicitation, or financial-return promotion.
